product.name: Angara GenAI Agent
product.tagline: QA that proves itself — not just produces text.
product.disclaimer: Interactive product story with sample data.

scenes.title: Ship QA that can defend itself.
scenes.body: One agent loop: ticket + MRs → grounded suite → independent quality gate → browser run → Xray. Humans stay on Save and bugs.

scenes.title: Normal tools leave holes.
scenes.body: Chatbots invent steps. TMS libraries stay hand-written. Code review never becomes a test. Playback scripts shatter on every UI shift.

cards.p: Pretty cases. Weak grounding. No AC proof.
Great library. Still typed by hand. Blind to MRs.
Findings die in a tab. Ports re-reviewed 3×.
Record-play breaks. No NL. Auto-bugs spam Jira.

scenes.title: One run. Five power moments.
scenes.body: Review and generate overlap — defects become checklist items before anyone hits Save.

steps.p: Ticket, comments, designs, every live MR
Multi-MR CR while the suite writes
CUA or Playwright on the real site
Xray / Jira — or MCP from Cursor

scenes.title: Ticket-first. Diff-aware. Coverage proven.
scenes.body: Ledger from the story before the code. Requirement cases without the diff. Change cases for what the ledger is silent on. Every item proven in expected results.

ticket.summary: FedEx Pickup at checkout — US only
ac: Place Order disabled until location chosen

scenes.title: Multi-MR findings become tests.
scenes.body: Every loaded live MR in one run. Identical diffs reviewed once. Confirmed bugs join the checklist as F items the suite must prove.

bugs.t: API error shown as empty locations
Pickup mounts without US store guard

scenes.title: Independent quality gate. Weakest score wins.
scenes.body: A reviewer that did not write the suite scores seven parameters. Averages cannot hide bad dedup. Pass = every param ≥ 70.
scenes.dedupe: 52 → 41 cases · 8 merges · coverage guard undoes bad folds

scenes.title: Real browsers. Human-gated bugs.
scenes.body: CUA drives the storefront in natural language. Automation Workbench turns English into Playwright. Failures wait for a person — never auto-spam Jira.

scenes.title: More than a generator.
scenes.body: Same agent in the IDE, the browser, and your ALM — with cost, schedules, and RBAC.

grid.p: tc_author · cua · bug_triage · code_review in Cursor / Claude
Publish sets & executions. Sync statuses. Real reporter.
Behavior packs so cases match how the store really works.
Per-run spend from Langfuse — leadership can see the bill.
Jira picker rules generate & save while you sleep.

scenes.title: Built to win the buyer conversation.
scenes.body: Grounded. Gated. Multi-MR. Executable. Published. That stack is what chatbots and TMS alone cannot claim.
points: Ticket ledger before the diff — assert requirements, not shipped labels
Coverage is proven in expected results — not vibes
CR findings become F items in the same run
Dedupe merges; coverage guard refuses merges that drop proof
House cases every storefront suite must carry
Humans gate Save and bug filing

scenes.title: Ready when your QA org is.
scenes.body: Walk a real ticket through Generate → multi-MR review → gate → CUA → Xray. One loop. Defensible QA.
